transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. I’m here because flying has started to feel... well, way scarier than it really should. Just the idea of getting on a plane makes me picture this bad turbulence we had on my honeymoon flight again. I mean, I know people fly safely every single day, but it's just getting to me more than it used to.
Is your fear mainly limited to flying?
Yeah, pretty much. It's really just flying. I don't... I don't have any issues with heights or, you know, small spaces or anything like that. It's just planes.
Do unwanted memories of that turbulent honeymoon flight ever suddenly pop into your mind when you’re not trying to think about it?

No, not really. I don't... it's not like they just pop up out of nowhere when I'm at work or doing normal things. I really only picture it if I'm actively thinking about having to fly somewhere, or if I'm looking at booking a ticket. Otherwise, it doesn't really cross my mind.
When you’re about to fly, do you ever have a sudden surge of intense fear that peaks within a few minutes?

No, I wouldn't say I get a sudden surge of fear like that. It's more of just a steady, uncomfortable feeling that builds up when I know I have to get on a plane. It doesn't really peak quickly or feel like a panic attack or anything. I just get really nervous and dread it the whole time.
